objective: One-click clear active layer and discoverable global pen-button settings in cumulative preview

Locked/empty disabled and handlers safe/no empty history. Hidden unlocked layer can be cleared deliberately from selected layer properties.

Setting changes do not mutate board/history or active gesture. Existing global pressure profile unchanged; per-brush override feature is not part of this slice. Settings popover respects close/Escape/outside-dismiss/native touch/mobile and gesture ownership; controls saved offline with existing pen config.
